parameters.content:
## Run an anonymous whistleblower channel with deadline tracking

### How it works
An anonymous form takes a report; no name or login is required. A Code node screens the text against your urgency rules table (seed it with phrases such as danger to life, retaliation or money laundering, in any language you need), creates a case number and a one-time access code, and stores only a SHA-256 hash of that code. If the reporter chooses to leave a contact, it is saved with the case; otherwise nothing identifying is kept. Groq classifies the report and writes a neutral summary for the case handler; its influence on urgency is capped, so text pasted into the report cannot force or suppress an escalation, and an empty rules table sends the case to manual review instead of auto-triage. Every case lands in a register with the two deadlines the EU Whistleblower Directive sets: acknowledgment within 7 days and feedback within 3 months. A second form lets the reporter check the case status later using the case number and access code, still anonymously.

### Setup
1. Add your Groq credential to the Groq Chat Model node.
2. Create the two data tables and select them in the three data table nodes. The template description lists the columns and starter rules.
3. Adjust deadlines and thresholds in Set Channel Policy.

This supports an internal reporting channel; it does not replace legal advice on your local whistleblower law.

## Anonymous intake and policy
The form requires no identity. Set Channel Policy holds the numbers a company may change: acknowledgment days, feedback days, urgency threshold, model cap.

## Rules scan and case creation
Matches the report against the urgency rules table, then creates the case number and access code. Only the SHA-256 hash of the code is ever stored.

## Bounded AI triage
Groq classifies and summarises. The report is untrusted input: instructions inside it are summarised, never followed, and the model's urgency influence is capped in the next node.

## Verdict, deadlines and register
Combines rule points with the capped model hint, computes the 7-day and 3-month due dates, and writes the case row. An empty rules table forces manual review.

## One-time receipts
Both endings show the case number and access code exactly once, with the two legal due dates. Urgent cases additionally point to emergency services.

## Anonymous status lookup
The reporter enters case number and access code. The code is hashed and compared with the stored hash; the failure page never reveals which value was wrong.
